title: A Partisan Future for Local News?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯《DealBook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》旗下栏目。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 在11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将对精选访谈进行现场直播，任何人都可以于11月

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 18日在nytimes.com免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费权限，畅读我们所有的严肃新闻。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: A Times investigation finds that as the local news industry collapses, a secretive network of pay-to-play news sites is seeking to take its place.
sentences.zh: 《时报》的一项调查发现，随着地方新闻行业的崩溃，一个由付费新闻网站组成的秘密网络正试图取而代之。

sentences.en: My colleagues, Davey Alba and Jack Nickus, on the company trying to rewrite the rules of American journalism.
sentences.zh: 我的同事戴维·阿尔巴和杰克·尼克斯将带我们了解这家试图重写美国新闻业规则的公司。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月28日星期三。

sentences.en: Ever since I was a little kid, I had a newspaper probably when I was six, and I would go up the street and interview.
sentences.zh: 从我很小的时候起，大概六岁时我就有了一份报纸，我会去街上采访。

sentences.en: I still remember there was like a lady from Sweden and an eye doctor
sentences.zh: 我依然记得当时有个来自瑞典的女士、一个眼科医生

sentences.en: and a priest from Ireland, and I would interview them and get their life stories and would put out my little newspaper.
sentences.zh: 还有一个来自爱尔兰的神父，我会采访他们并了解他们的人生故事，然后出版我自己的小报纸。

sentences.en: And then, you know, when I came of age, it was the Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，当我到了成年的时候，正赶上越南战争。

sentences.en: And I got into it, frankly, because I think, you know, truth is important.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我之所以涉足这一行，是因为我认为，真相至关重要。

sentences.en: And I also, at that time, very naively, you know, I believed that people were uninformed.
sentences.zh: 而且在当时，我也非常天真地认为，人们只是缺乏了解。

sentences.en: And once they knew the truth, then they'd act differently.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们知道了真相，他们的行事方式就会有所不同。

sentences.en: So, Davey and Jack, tell me about Pat Morris.
sentences.zh: 那么，戴维和杰克，跟我讲讲帕特·莫里斯吧。

sentences.en: So, Pat Morris is a 69-year-old freelance writer.
sentences.zh: 帕特·莫里斯是一位69岁的自由撰稿人。

sentences.en: She is now based in Newport-Ritchie in Florida.
sentences.zh: 她目前常驻佛罗里达州的纽波特里奇。

sentences.en: Her entire career has been in journalism.
sentences.zh: 她的整个职业生涯都在从事新闻工作。

sentences.en: So, I wound up writing for papers like the East Village Other, New York Ace, The Herald, those types of papers.
sentences.zh: 我最后开始为诸如《东村另类报》、《纽约王牌》、《先驱报》之类类型的报纸写稿。

sentences.en: I moved to Cincinnati and worked for an alternative paper called Everybody's
sentences.zh: 我搬到了辛辛那提，为一份名为《人人

sentences.en: News.
sentences.zh: 新闻》的另类报纸工作。

sentences.en: She worked for a variety of alternative newspapers and also various local newspapers around the country.
sentences.zh: 她曾为各种另类报纸以及全国各地不同的地方报纸工作过。

sentences.en: I was an editor for a Jewish newspaper called The American Israelite, which is, I consider it a community paper, even though it's not a geographic community.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一家名为《美国以色列人报》的犹太报纸的编辑，我认为这是一份社区报纸，尽管它并不是一个地理意义上的社区。

sentences.en: Bouncing around different publications, including in North Carolina and even the Virgin Islands.
sentences.zh: 辗转于不同的出版物，包括北卡罗来纳州甚至美属维尔京群岛的出版物。

sentences.en: And I was really having a ball, just writing what I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的玩得很开心，只是写我想写的东西。

sentences.en: And then did end up as a copy editor at the Florham Park Eagle in New Jersey and sort of thought that she would have a steady job there, but...
sentences.zh: 后来她确实在新泽西州的《弗洛勒姆帕克鹰报》担任过突发新闻编辑，并且一度以为自己能在那里找到一份稳定的工作，但是……

sentences.en: I kind of took that job just in time for the financial collapse around 2008.
sentences.zh: 我接下那份工作的时间刚刚好赶上2008年左右的金融崩盘。

sentences.en: I think the industry probably was collapsing 2007, 2008, and then the whole economy tanked.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个行业可能在2007、2008年就开始崩溃了，接着整个经济都陷入了低谷。

sentences.en: There were a lot of cutbacks and a lot of people who were laid off, and Pat Morris was one of them.
sentences.zh: 有大量的缩减和许多被解雇的人，帕特·莫里斯就是其中之一。

sentences.en: So, what does she end up doing after that?
sentences.zh: 那么，她在那之后做了什么呢？

sentences.en: So, after she gets laid off, she does a bunch of freelance jobs, and then in 2018, starts at a
sentences.zh: 所以，在她被解雇后，她做了一堆自由职业，然后在2018年，开始在一家

sentences.en: little-known company called Franklin Archer, which she eventually starts to think of as a content mill.
sentences.zh: 鲜为人知的公司富兰克林·阿彻（Franklin Archer）工作，她最终开始把这家公司看作是一个内容加工厂。

sentences.en: And Jack, what exactly is a content mill?
sentences.zh: 杰克，内容加工厂到底是什么？

sentences.en: A content mill is a phenomenon in the internet age of journalism.
sentences.zh: 内容加工厂是互联网时代新闻业的一种现象。

sentences.en: Essentially, these are sites that churn out basic stories to generate clicks and sell ads.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这些网站是为了产生点击量和销售广告而大量炮制基础故事的平台。

sentences.en: And it's everything from the sort of clickbait we see beneath a lot of news articles like, you'll never believe what these child celebrities look like now.
sentences.zh: 这包含了各种各样的内容，比如我们在许多新闻报道下方看到的这类标题党：“你绝不会相信这些童星现在长什么样”。

sentences.en: I totally click on those, yes.
sentences.zh: 我完全会点进去，是的。

sentences.en: To more basic articles for maybe trade publications, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 一直到也许是面向行业出版物等的更基础的文章。

sentences.en: And these sorts of jobs are what a lot of journalists had to get into after the economic recession in 2008,
sentences.zh: 这类工作是许多记者在2008年经济衰退后不得不涉足的领域，

sentences.en: because so many traditional journalism jobs, particularly at local newspapers, were disappearing.
sentences.zh: 因为太多传统的新闻工作，尤其是地方报纸的工作，都在消失。

sentences.en: So, Pat came across this job at Franklin Archer that just seemed like writing local news stories across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以帕特在富兰克林·阿彻碰巧看到了这份工作，它看起来就像是在美国各地撰写地方新闻报道，

sentences.en: from, you know, where she lived in Florida.
sentences.zh: 就从她居住的佛罗里达州开始。

sentences.en: And so I applied, and I got a job as a copy editor.
sentences.zh: 于是我申请了，并得到了一份文案编辑的工作。

sentences.en: They said I'd be copy editing stuff from a variety of their clients.
sentences.zh: 他们说我将负责编辑他们各个客户的内容。

sentences.en: I thought that the clients were actual established entities that had contracted with Franklin Archer for content,
sentences.zh: 我以为这些客户都是与富兰克林·阿彻签约提供内容的实际成熟实体，

sentences.en: which is what everybody does now, you know, because you don't have staff, and you don't have reporters, and you don't have journalism.
sentences.zh: 这也是现在每个人都在做的事情，你知道的，因为你没有员工，你没有记者，你也没有新闻。

sentences.en: You have content.
sentences.zh: 你有的只是内容。

sentences.en: So, Pat understands that she has become a local news reporter for a company called Franklin Archer
sentences.zh: 因此，帕特明白她已经成为了一家名为富兰克林·阿彻的公司的本地新闻记者，

sentences.en: that sells her articles to a variety of different local newspapers across the country.
sentences.zh: 该公司将她的文章出售给全国各地的各种不同地方报纸。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So maybe not the best thing for a local newspaper, especially if you're a reporter there, but pretty good for Pat Morris.
sentences.zh: 所以这对于地方报纸来说可能不是最好的事情，特别是如果你是那里的记者的话，但对帕特·莫里斯来说相当不错。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是的。

sentences.en: You got paid on time, all the time.
sentences.zh: 你每次都能按时拿到报酬。

sentences.en: It was direct deposit.
sentences.zh: 那是直接转账。

sentences.en: It was weekly, and then it became every other week.
sentences.zh: 是每周一次，后来变成了每两周一次。

sentences.en: I never, I gotta say, I never had an issue.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我从来没有遇到过问题。

sentences.en: You know, it was just a big draw when you're a freelancer.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对于一个自由职业者来说，这有着巨大的吸引力。

sentences.en: You know, that you knew, like, every week you were gonna have, even if it was just $100, you know, you knew you were gonna have that, I think is very attractive to people.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你很清楚，就像每周你都会有收入，哪怕只有100美元，你知道你都会有，我认为这对人们非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: And what kinds of stories does that mean Pat ends up working on?
sentences.zh: 这意味着帕特最终都在做什么样的主题故事呢？

sentences.en: Well, she works on a lot of just community-based stories.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她做了很多基于社区的故事。

sentences.en: It wasn't hard news.
sentences.zh: 这不是硬新闻。

sentences.en: It was all soft, featurey stuff.
sentences.zh: 全都是软性的、特写式的内容。

sentences.en: You know, the police department having human trafficking awareness prograMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如警察局开展人口贩运意识项目。

sentences.en: The fire department doing whatever the fire department did.
sentences.zh: 消防局做消防局会做的那些事。

sentences.en: Recycling, this company that does, recycles plastic bags into tables.
sentences.zh: 回收利用，某个将塑料袋回收制成桌子的公司。

sentences.en: You know, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Right, there were kind of meat and potatoes of local news.
sentences.zh: 没错，这些可以说是地方新闻的核心与基石。

sentences.en: Absolutely, yeah.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的，是的。

sentences.en: But from the beginning, there were also signs that something was a little bit off about this job.
sentences.zh: 但从一开始，也有迹象表明这份工作有点不对劲。

sentences.en: They said a lot of the clients are conservative.
sentences.zh: 他们说很多客户都是保守派。

sentences.en: Is that a problem for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是个问题吗？

sentences.en: I remember specifically, I asked, well, what do you mean by conservative?
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得，我问过，好吧，你们所说的保守派是什么意思？

sentences.en: You know, are you talking about white supremacist stuff?
sentences.zh: 你们是在说白人至上主义那一套吗？

sentences.en: Are you talking about, and it was like, oh, no, no, no, nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 你们在说的是，然后对方就说，哦，不，不，不，完全不是那样的。

sentences.en: You know, but a lot of the, again, it's the clients are, you know, kind of pro-business.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但很多，再次强调，客户都是那种亲商业的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, okay, I can, if it's pro-business, I can edit that, you know.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我可以，如果是亲商业的，我可以编辑，你知道的。

sentences.en: She gets tons of assignments, chunks of them that are focused on local politicians,
sentences.zh: 她接到了大量的任务，其中相当一部分专注于地方政治家，

sentences.en: Republicans specifically.
sentences.zh: 特别是共和党人。

sentences.en: And she is really uncomfortable with the way it seems very one-sided to her.
sentences.zh: 而且她对这种在她看来非常偏颇的倾向感到非常不舒服。

sentences.en: So she actually starts to turn down these assignments and try to do these very simple local
sentences.zh: 所以她实际上开始拒绝这些任务，并试图去做那些关于消防局、

sentences.en: pieces on the fire department and, you know, the community board meeting and things like that.
sentences.zh: 社区董事会会议之类非常简单的地方报道。

sentences.en: But these sites turn out so much political content that it becomes hard to avoid for her.
sentences.zh: 但这些网站产出了如此多的政治内容，以至于她很难避开。

sentences.en: And at one point, she gets a rather interesting assignment.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时候，她接到了一项相当有趣的任务。

sentences.en: So Pat's assignment is copy editing this story about a class at the University of Illinois.
sentences.zh: 所以帕特的任务是编辑这篇关于伊利诺伊大学一门课程的故事。

sentences.en: It was this absolutely alarmist story about how a literature class was looking at a book that had sexual content.
sentences.zh: 这是一个绝对危言耸听的故事，讲的是一门文学课是如何审视一本包含性内容的书籍的。

sentences.en: And it was, oh, you know, sexual content and, you know, in a college level literature course.
sentences.zh: 而且内容是，哦，你知道的，性内容，而且是在大学水平的文学课程中。

sentences.en: And in an earlier draft of this story, there's a student that's so outraged by this that they dropped the course.
sentences.zh: 在这个故事的早期草稿中，有一个学生对此感到极其愤怒，以至于退出了这门课。

sentences.en: So I thought that was pretty bizarre.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这非常怪异。

sentences.en: And then as I read on, supposedly this student, unnamed student, was so traumatized by the whole thing that they either quit the class or they quit school.
sentences.zh: 然后当我继续读下去时，据说这个学生，这个未具名的学生，被整件事严重创伤，以至于他们要么退出了这门课，要么退学了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm reading it and I'm going, this is really weird.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我读着它，然后心想，这真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: And Pat asks a very reasonable fact-checking question.
sentences.zh: 帕特提出了一个非常合理的事实核查问题。

sentences.en: So I went back to the reporter because I, you know, and said, well, can you identify these people, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以我回过头去找记者，因为我，你知道的，然后说，好吧，你能确认这些人的身份吗？

sentences.en: How do you know that the student quit?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道那个学生退学了？

sentences.en: Can you attribute this to a source?
sentences.zh: 你能把这个归咎于某个消息源吗？

sentences.en: This mysterious student, you know, I heard about this student who quit.
sentences.zh: 这个神秘的学生，你知道的，我听说过这个退学的学生。

sentences.en: Well, who was it, you know?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是谁，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And did they really quit?
sentences.zh: 他们真的退学了吗？

sentences.en: And the writer basically says, I can't attribute that fact in the story because this came directly from Brian.
sentences.zh: 而作者基本上说，我无法在报道中把这个事实归于任何人，因为这是直接来自布赖恩的。

sentences.en: And I didn't know who Brian was.
sentences.zh: 而我当时并不知道布赖恩是谁。

sentences.en: I think I said that.
sentences.zh: 我想我是这么说的。

sentences.en: Well, who's Brian?
sentences.zh: 好吧，布赖恩是谁？

sentences.en: And I got back this thing from somebody else.
sentences.zh: 然后我收到了来自其他人的回复。

sentences.en: Like, Brian is the company.
sentences.zh: 就像是，布赖恩就是公司。

sentences.en: What he wants, we want.
sentences.zh: 他想要什么，我们就想要什么。

sentences.en: And it's, okay.
sentences.zh: 然后，好吧。

sentences.en: So who is Brian?
sentences.zh: 所以布赖恩是谁？

sentences.en: Brian, she learns, is the top dog in this organization that she has a job at.
sentences.zh: 她了解到，布赖恩是她工作的这个组织里的大老板。

sentences.en: And in an email, she actually hears from her assigning editor saying whatever Brian wants goes.
sentences.zh: 在一封电子邮件中，她确实收到了指派编辑的消息，说布赖恩想要什么，一切就得听什么的。

sentences.en: And it didn't even seem odd to me because I had worked in another place where the line between editorial and business was very, very blurred.
sentences.zh: 这甚至对我来说并不显得奇怪，因为我曾在另一个地方工作过，在那里，编辑与商业之间的界限非常非常模糊。

sentences.en: And did you ever find out more about who Brian was?
sentences.zh: 那你有没有发现更多关于布赖恩是谁的信息？

sentences.en: Well, I was told, you know, Brian, then I got emails from Brian Chimpone, so I knew his name, which is pretty much all I knew until I was contacted by the Times.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我被告知，你知道的，布赖恩，然后我收到了布赖恩·奇姆蓬的电子邮件，所以我知道了他的名字，这基本上就是我所知道的一切，直到《时报》联系我。

sentences.en: So you got a call from us.
sentences.zh: 所以你接到了我们的电话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And why were you calling Pat?
sentences.zh: 你们当时为什么要给帕特打电话？

sentences.en: Well, we were reaching out to Pat because Davey and I were trying to talk to anyone who had ever worked for this guy, Brian Chimpone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们联系帕特是因为戴维和我正试图与任何曾为这个名叫布赖恩·奇姆蓬的家伙工作过的人交谈。

sentences.en: And that's because it turns out that Brian has got a lot more going on than Pat had realized.
sentences.zh: 这是因为事实证明，布赖恩所做的事情远比帕特所意识到的要多得多。

sentences.en: Brian is the man behind perhaps the biggest news operation you've never heard of.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩可能是你从未听说过的最大新闻运作机构背后的那个人。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us for another edition of Against the Current.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收看另一期的《逆流而上》。

sentences.en: My guest on this edition is Brian Chimpone.
sentences.zh: 我这一期的嘉宾是布赖恩·奇姆蓬。

sentences.en: And Brian got his start in news as a reporter for TV stations in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩最初是通过担任伊利诺伊州电视台记者的身份开始其新闻生涯的。

sentences.en: Brian, thanks for joining us.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩，谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Dan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我，丹。

sentences.en: But eventually he decided he didn't want to just report the news.
sentences.zh: 但最终他决定他不想仅仅报道新闻。

sentences.en: He wanted to be a newspaper publisher.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一名报纸出版商。

sentences.en: Media as it's perceived is content.
sentences.zh: 媒体如其所被感知的，就是内容。

sentences.en: And so he bought some community newspapers in Illinois and he started to see pretty early on the signs of collapse in the journalism industry and particularly in local news.
sentences.zh: 因此，他在伊利诺伊州买下了一些社区报纸，并且很早就开始看到新闻业尤其是地方新闻崩溃的迹象。

sentences.en: The problem with old traditional media today is that a lot of them produce as if we're in the previous era.
sentences.zh: 当今老牌传统媒体的问题在于，他们中的许多人的制作方式仿佛我们还身处上一个时代。

sentences.en: They produce the same types of content that worked in that previous era.
sentences.zh: 他们制作的仍然是那个旧时代行之有效的同类型内容。

sentences.en: And because of inertia, it stays.
sentences.zh: 并且由于惯性，它一直保留了下来。

sentences.en: So he decided that he was going to capitalize on that and he started a company called Jernatic.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定利用这一点，并创办了一家名为Jernatic的公司。

sentences.en: And this company essentially is designed to outsource the local news reporting for many of the big city papers around the country.
sentences.zh: 这家公司本质上旨在为全国许多大城市报纸外包地方新闻报道。

sentences.en: So what's your system?
sentences.zh: 那么你的系统是什么样的？

sentences.en: Your system is, I mean, essentially you're arguing that major urban dailies should outsource their news production to you.
sentences.zh: 你的系统是，我的意思是，本质上你在主张各大城市的日报应该把它们的新闻制作外包给你吗？

sentences.en: I don't think they should all outsource their news production.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们应该把所有新闻制作都外包出去。

sentences.en: Well, but isn't that what you do?
sentences.zh: 嗯，但难道这就是你所做的吗？

sentences.en: Community news, because they can't do it themselves.
sentences.zh: 社区新闻，因为他们自己做不到。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But describe that.
sentences.zh: 但请描述一下这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, how can you and your group of writers...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你和你的作家团队怎么能……

sentences.en: Do it for a 20th of the cost?
sentences.zh: 用二十分之一的成本来做？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做到的？

sentences.en: To do that, he develops some rudimentary software that turns public records into little snippets of news.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一点，他开发了一些基础的软件，把公开记录变成一小段一小段的新闻。

sentences.en: And then he also hires a team of reporters to cover communities remotely.
sentences.zh: 然后他还雇了一支记者团队来远程报道各个社区。

sentences.en: And to Brian, the idea here is local news is dying, and the old business model is not sustainable in the age of the internet.
sentences.zh: 对布赖恩来说，这里的理念是地方新闻正在消亡，而在互联网时代，旧的商业模式是不可持续的。

sentences.en: And this is a lower cost model to still provide local news to small towns and cities across the nation.
sentences.zh: 这是一种成本更低的模式，依然能够为全国各地的小城镇和城市提供地方新闻。

sentences.en: And to do that, Brian is selling this local news content to legacy news organizations like
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，布赖恩正在将这些地方新闻内容出售给传统新闻机构，比如

sentences.en: the Chicago Tribune and the Houston Chronicle, who themselves are trying to cut their costs.
sentences.zh: 《芝加哥论坛报》和《休斯敦纪事报》，它们自己也在设法削减成本。

sentences.en: And so how does it go?
sentences.zh: 那进展如何呢？

sentences.en: So it's going pretty well for Brian Temponi at this point, so much so that the Chicago Tribune
sentences.zh: 所以布赖恩·坦波尼目前进展得相当顺利，甚至《芝加哥论坛报》

sentences.en: actually fires its staff that covers the Chicago suburbs and uses Brian Temponi's operation to cover the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 竟然解雇了负责芝加哥郊区报道的员工，转而使用布赖恩·坦波尼的团队来报道郊区。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: You have that thought, what other jobs can we possibly outsource to people far away at this point?
sentences.zh: 你会有这种想法：到这个地步，我们究竟还能把什么其他工作外包给远方的人呢？

sentences.en: Sarah Canning tells this story of a fairly recent addition to the list of jobs.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·坎宁讲述了这个充斥着此类工作的新名单中相当近期的故事。

sentences.en: Back in November...
sentences.zh: 回到去年11月……

sentences.en: The radio program, This American Life, comes in and does a show that reveals that in a lot of cases...
sentences.zh: 广播节目《This American Life》介入并做了一期节目，揭露了在许多情况下……

sentences.en: The reporter's name on the story is Ginny Cox.
sentences.zh: 报道这篇故事的记者名字叫吉尼·考克斯。

sentences.en: But there is no Ginny Cox.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有吉尼·考克斯这个人。

sentences.en: Or even if there is a Ginny Cox somewhere out there, she didn't write this story.
sentences.zh: 或者即使在某处真的有个叫吉尼·考克斯的人，她也没有写过这个故事。

sentences.en: These stories are being written by people in the Philippines.
sentences.zh: 这些故事是由远在菲律宾的人写的。

sentences.en: And they get paid much less than an American writer would get paid to do these stories.
sentences.zh: 他们写这些故事得到的报酬，比美国本土作家要少得多。

sentences.en: And in a lot of these cases, they are also publishing under fake bylines.
sentences.zh: 而且在许多情况下，他们也是用假署名发表的。

sentences.en: Jeez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Some other fake names that have made their way onto the news sites of Jernatix clients in the real estate sections?
sentences.zh: 还有哪些假名字混进了杰尔纳蒂克斯房地产板块客户的新闻网站上？

sentences.en: Carrie Reed, Amy Anderson, Jay Brownstown, Christine Scott...
sentences.zh: 卡莉·里德、艾米·安德森、杰伊·布朗斯敦、克里斯蒂娜·斯科特……

sentences.en: So the clients of Brian are really outraged and say, you know, this is not what we're paying for.
sentences.zh: 所以布赖恩的客户们非常愤怒，他们说，你知道的，这根本不是我们花钱买的服务。

sentences.en: This is not what we signed up for.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是我们当初签约时想要的。

sentences.en: So they basically pull out of the deals with Brian and the whole operation kind of crashes and burns.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上退出了与布赖恩的交易，整个运作模式差不多彻底崩盘了。

sentences.en: So now Brian Temponi is facing failure, but from the ashes of Jernatix, he comes up with this new idea.
sentences.zh: 所以现在布赖恩·坦波尼面临着失败，但从杰尔纳蒂克斯的灰烬中，他想出了这个新点子。

sentences.en: And this new idea is bigger and it's bolder, and it involves an entirely new business model.
sentences.zh: 这个新点子规模更大、更大胆，而且涉及一个完全崭新的商业模式。

sentences.en: And it all starts now with a web of companies that includes Franklin Archer.
sentences.zh: 这一切现在从一个包含富兰克林·阿彻在内的公司网络开始了。

sentences.en: And how exactly is it different from Jernatix?
sentences.zh: 它和杰尔纳蒂克斯究竟有什么区别？

sentences.en: What's different this time around?
sentences.zh: 这次有什么不同？

sentences.en: It's different in a couple of key ways.
sentences.zh: 它在几个关键方面有所不同。

sentences.en: A, the writers in this network are now American freelancers, no longer the Filipino workers abroad.
sentences.zh: A，这个网络中的写手现在是美国的自由撰稿人，不再是国外的菲律宾工人了。

sentences.en: And B, the news articles that they're producing are for websites that look like local news,
sentences.zh: B，他们制作的新闻文章是用于那些看起来像地方新闻、

sentences.en: but are actually primarily controlled by Brian Temponi himself and appear to be based around the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但实际上主要由布赖恩·坦波尼本人控制且看起来立足于美国的网站。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And so what are they like?
sentences.zh: 那它们是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, I think I should just show you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我应该直接展示给你看。

sentences.en: It's probably easieSt.
sentences.zh: 这可能是最简单的办法。

sentences.en: So let's go to a website called Thumb Reporter.
sentences.zh: 所以我们去一个叫“姆指记者”的网站看看。

sentences.en: Thumbreporter.com.
sentences.zh: Thumbreporter.com.

sentences.en: And Thumb is actually a region of Michigan.
sentences.zh: 而“姆指”其实是密歇根的一个地区。

sentences.en: The lower peninsula of Michigan is kind of shaped like a mitten.
sentences.zh: 密歇根的下半岛形状有点像连指手套。

sentences.en: And the Thumb of Michigan is just north of Detroit, east of the Tri-Cities in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 而密歇根的姆指区就在底特律的正北方，密歇根三市的东边。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you're there?
sentences.zh: 那么你到了吗？

sentences.en: Thumbreporter.com?
sentences.zh: Thumbreporter.com?

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm on Thumbreporter.com.
sentences.zh: Yeah, I'm on Thumbreporter.com.

sentences.en: My first observation is that it looks like a regular local news website.
sentences.zh: 我的第一印象是它看起来像一个常规的地方新闻网站。

sentences.en: A lot of news stories, a lot of political news stories.
sentences.zh: 有很多新闻报道，有很多政治新闻报道。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's a pretty clean, simple layout.
sentences.zh: 对，而且它的排版相当干净、简单。

sentences.en: It doesn't look real clickbaity or anything.
sentences.zh: 看起来一点也不像那种骗点击量的东西。

sentences.en: It's, you know, pretty basic layout with some photos of politicians.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它是一个相当基础的排版，配有一些政客的照片。

sentences.en: And there's a good amount of content as you scroll down.
sentences.zh: 当你向下滚动时，有相当数量的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's about 12 articles on this first screen.
sentences.zh: 对，在这个首屏上大约有12篇文章。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess, you know, at the outset, let's just take stock of some of these headlines.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想，在一开始，让我们先盘点一下其中一些头条新闻。

sentences.en: The top headline is about this local Republican lawmaker who's praising a court order that struck down the Democratic governor's COVID policies.
sentences.zh: 头条新闻是关于一位当地的共和党议员赞扬了一项推翻民主党州长新冠政策的法院裁决。

sentences.en: Then there's another headline about a different Republican lawmaker complaining that Michigan should fully reopen the economy.
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一条头条是关于另一位共和党议员抱怨密歇根应该全面重启经济。

sentences.en: There's another headline about one of the same Republican lawmakers passing four bills.
sentences.zh: 还有一条头条是关于其中一位共和党议员通过了四项法案。

sentences.en: There's another headline about a Republican lawmaker who's going to help local farmers.
sentences.zh: 还有一条头条是关于一位将要帮助当地农民的共和党议员。

sentences.en: And then another headline about a Republican lawmaker who's talking about voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 接着又是一条关于一位谈论选民欺诈的共和党议员的头条。

sentences.en: And I think I'm seeing a clear trend here.
sentences.zh: 我想我在这里看出了一种明显的趋势。

sentences.en: Lots of coverage of Republicans, lots of positive coverage of Republicans.
sentences.zh: 大量关于共和党的报道，大量对共和党的正面报道。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there is, though, one story about a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实有一篇关于民主党人的报道。

sentences.en: And the headline is Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer gets F grade for fiscal management.
sentences.zh: 头条是：密歇根州长格雷琴·惠特默因财政管理不善获得F级评分。

sentences.en: And it's a report about this study from the libertarian think tank, the Cato Institute.
sentences.zh: 这是一篇关于自由主义智库卡托研究所这项研究的报告。

sentences.en: And this is a trend that Pat saw in her assignments for Franklin Archer.
sentences.zh: 这也是帕特在为富兰克林·阿彻的工作中发现的一种趋势。

sentences.en: And it's a trend that we're seeing across the board on websites run by Ryan Temponi.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在由瑞安·坦波尼运营的网站上普遍看到的趋势。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And this is just one example of a website in the network.
sentences.zh: 这只是该网络中众多网站的一个例子。

sentences.en: What we found is that there are almost 1,300 websites like this.
sentences.zh: 我们发现有将近1300个这样的网站。

sentences.en: And they're in all 50 states.
sentences.zh: 它们遍布所有50个州。

sentences.en: And do all these websites take this approach of positively covering Republicans in general and negatively covering Democrats?
sentences.zh: 难道所有这些网站都采取这种总体上正面报道共和党、负面报道民主党的方针吗？

sentences.en: Pretty much, yeah.
sentences.zh: 基本上是的。

sentences.en: But there are some innocuous articles on these websites, too.
sentences.zh: 但这些网站上也有一些无伤大雅的文章。

sentences.en: And these just are straight news articles about the local community.
sentences.zh: 这些就是关于当地社区的纯粹新闻报道。

sentences.en: But they seem to be in service of adding legitimacy and to make the sites look more neutral than they really are.
sentences.zh: 但它们似乎是为了增加合法性，让这些网站看起来比实际更加中立。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，还不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, what exactly is going on here?
sentences.zh: 那么，这里到底在发生什么？

sentences.en: I mean, how should we be thinking about what this latest Brian Temponi news operation is?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们该如何看待布赖恩·坦波尼这最新的一家新闻机构呢？

sentences.en: Because, as I said earlier, this does not seem like what someone like Pat Morris thought they were signing up for.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我刚才所说，这看起来不像帕特·莫里斯这样的人以为他们签约时会做的事。

sentences.en: What exactly is this?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么？

sentences.en: So, Davey and I set out to answer that very question.
sentences.zh: 因此，戴维和我着手回答正是这个问题。

sentences.en: And after many months of reporting, we found out that this is not a traditional journalism outfit.
sentences.zh: 经过数月的报道，我们发现这不是一个传统的新闻机构。

sentences.en: In fact, it is a pay-for-play operation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一个付费发文的运作机构。

sentences.en: And in many cases, we found evidence of a money trail where a good chunk of the funding for these sites, traceable in public records,
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，我们找到了资金流向的证据，这些网站相当一部分资金（可在公开记录中追溯）

sentences.en: are payments from political groups and campaigns.
sentences.zh: 是来自政治团体和竞选活动的付款。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That is very untraditional journalism, if it can even be called journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果这甚至还能被称为新闻业的话，那这真是极度非传统的新闻业。

sentences.en: It certainly is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it helps explain why you see some of the slant that we just saw on that news website.
sentences.zh: 这有助于解释为什么你在那个新闻网站上看到了一些我们刚刚见过的偏向性。

sentences.en: And essentially, you know,
sentences.zh: 本质上，你知道的，

sentences.en: some of what we found through thousands of internal emails and also the editing history behind dozens of stories was an operation in which some of these groups,
sentences.zh: 我们通过数千封内部邮件以及几十篇故事背后的编辑历史发现了一些情况：某些团体——

sentences.en: political groups or PR professionals, actually pitch or order the stories to Temponi's network.
sentences.zh: 政治团体或公关专业人士，实际上在向坦波尼的网络提供或点单故事。

sentences.en: And they file what is called a lead in which they give instructions on what the story should be about, who the reporter should talk to, what questions they should ask.
sentences.zh: 他们提交所谓的导语，在其中给出关于故事应该关于什么、记者应该和谁交谈、他们应该问什么问题的指示。

sentences.en: And then after the story is published, we even found some instances in emails in which these so-called story watchers, as these clients are called,
sentences.zh: 然后，在故事发表后，我们甚至在电子邮件中发现了一些实例：这些所谓的“故事监督员”（这些客户被称为这个名字），

sentences.en: are able to even dictate edits after publication if they wanted the story to be more pointed or focus on something more.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想让故事更尖锐或更聚焦于某些事情，甚至能够在发表后决定修改意见。

sentences.en: And so, as you noted, this is almost the antithesis of the journalism ethics that most news organizations would abide by.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如你所注意到的，这几乎是大多数新闻机构会遵守的新闻道德的对立面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's actually essentially a propaganda network.
sentences.zh: 它实际上本质上是一个宣传网络。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So just so I have this straight, Republican candidates, conservative donors, are paying money to Brian Temponi's company.
sentences.zh: 为了让我理清头绪，共和党候选人、保守派捐赠者正在向布赖恩·坦波尼的公司付钱。

sentences.en: And as part of that transaction, they can ask for coverage.
sentences.zh: 作为该交易的一部分，他们可以要求进行报道。

sentences.en: They can monitor coverage.
sentences.zh: 他们可以监控报道。

sentences.en: They can get involved in shaping it, who is talked to for that coverage.
sentences.zh: 他们可以参与塑造报道内容，以及为了该报道应该和谁交谈。

sentences.en: That's what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: In some cases, that's exactly what we found.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，这正是我们所发现的。

sentences.en: And is any of this disclosed to the reader?
sentences.zh: 所有这些有向读者披露吗？

sentences.en: Virtually none of these sites have those kinds of disclosures.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有一个网站有这类披露。

sentences.en: In fact, the sites go out of their way to state that they are objective and fair and unbiased in their coverage.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些网站竭尽全力声称他们在报道中是客观、公正和不偏不倚的。

sentences.en: And then at the same time that these descriptions are on the sites,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，当这些描述出现在网站上时，

sentences.en: we have seen internal emails where assigning editors are telling their freelance writers not to focus any article on a Democratic lawmaker or bill because their clients are Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了内部邮件：指派编辑告诉他们的自由撰稿人，不要把任何文章的焦点放在民主党议员或法案上，因为他们的客户是共和党人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I wonder, Zach, if you can give me an example of how this pay-to-play system works.
sentences.zh: 扎克，我想知道你是否能给我举个例子，说明这种付费发文系统是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Kind of break down an example for me.
sentences.zh: 为我剖析一个例子吧。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So one of the most compelling examples we found was around an article on a website called Main Business Daily.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的最引人注目的例子之一是关于一个名为“商业每日在线”网站上的一篇文章。

sentences.en: And this article is about one of the most hotly contested and nationally important Senate races in November.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章是关于11月份竞争最激烈、在全国范围内最重要的参议院竞选之一。

sentences.en: It's between Republican Senator Susan Collins and her Democratic challenger, Sarah Gideon.
sentences.zh: 它是共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯与她的民主党挑战者萨拉·吉ideon之间的竞选。

sentences.en: So what we found is the reporter who wrote this story did so according to clear instructions from a Republican operative who has worked for the Senate Leadership Fund,
sentences.zh: 所以我们发现，写这篇报道的记者是按照一名曾为参议院领导基金（Senate Leadership Fund）

sentences.en: a PAC that has spent nearly $10 million attacking Sarah Gideon in this cycle.
sentences.zh: ——一个在这个选举周期花费了近1000万美元攻击萨拉·吉ideon的政治行动委员会——工作的共和党特工的明确指示来写的。

sentences.en: And that operative gave clear instructions to the reporter to write that Sarah Gideon was a hypocrite.
sentences.zh: 该特工向记者下达了明确指示，要写萨拉·吉ideon是个伪君子。

sentences.en: And we even found in internal emails that the operative requested edits to the story after it was first published.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至在内部邮件中发现，该特工在故事首次发表后要求对故事进行修改。

sentences.en: And the resulting story was based solely on accusations from the Senator Collins campaign and never included comment from Sarah Gideon.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的报道完全基于参议员柯林斯竞选团队的指控，从未包含来自萨拉·吉ideon的评论。

sentences.en: It sounds like this Republican operative got exactly the story he wanted, slamming the Democratic candidate for United States Senate for being two-faced.
sentences.zh: 听起来这位共和党特工得到了他想要的故事，猛烈抨击竞选美国参议员的民主党候选人表里不一。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And he not only got this story,
sentences.zh: 他不仅得到了这个故事，

sentences.en: but we also found his fingerprints on a number of stories about this Senate race in Maine and also the Senate race in South Carolina with Lindsey Graham and in Missouri with Roy Blunt.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还发现他的指纹出现在多篇关于缅因州这场参议院竞选的故事中，还有南卡罗来纳州与林赛·格雷厄姆以及密苏里州与罗伊·布朗特的参议院竞选中。

sentences.en: And what about the story that you told me about earlier, the one Pat was copyediting, about the literature class at the University of Illinois?
sentences.zh: 那关于你之前跟我讲的故事，帕特一直在审校的那篇关于伊利诺伊大学文学课的故事呢？

sentences.en: That article is not a clear-cut pay-to-play situation as far as we can tell, but we do know a few things.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，那篇文章并不是一个明确的付费发文情况，但我们确实知道一些事情。

sentences.en: What we found in emails is that Jeannie Ives, a Republican candidate for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们在邮件中发现，伊利诺伊州美国众议院共和党候选人珍妮·艾夫斯（Jeannie Ives）

sentences.en: House in Illinois, actually corresponded with Brian Timponi to get the story written.
sentences.zh: 确实与布赖恩·蒂姆波尼进行了沟通，以促成这篇故事的撰写。

sentences.en: And we also know from public documents that Jeannie Ives has paid Timponi's company's $55,000, according to state and federal records, over the past three years.
sentences.zh: 我们还从公开文件中得知，根据州和联邦记录，在过去三年里，珍妮·艾夫斯已经向蒂姆波尼的公司支付了5.5万美元。

sentences.en: I do want to note that I did reach Jeannie Ives, and she told me that those payments to Brian were for website design and Facebook ads, and that she doesn't pay to plant stories.
sentences.zh: 我确实想指出，我联系到了珍妮·艾夫斯，她告诉我，给布赖恩的那些款项是用于网站设计和Facebook广告，她并没有付钱来买通故事。

sentences.en: And Jack, were you able to understand why Jeannie Ives, local Republican political candidate, cared about a literature class at the University of Illinois?
sentences.zh: 杰克，你是否能理解为什么当地共和党政治候选人珍妮·艾夫斯会关心伊利诺伊大学的一门文学课？

sentences.en: In this particular case, we don't.
sentences.zh: 在这个特定案例中，我们不得而知。

sentences.en: We're unsure whether this is a personal or ideological issue for her, but it's almost beside the point, because what's important for us here is to understand how,
sentences.zh: 我们不确定这是否是她的个人或意识形态问题，但这几乎是题外话，因为对我们而言重要的是要了解如何

sentences.en: probably because of her payments to Brian Timponi, she is able to get her pet issues published on his sites.
sentences.zh: 很可能是因为她对布赖恩·蒂姆波尼的付款，她才能够把她关心的议题发表在他的网站上。

sentences.en: And, Michael, these are just two examples that we've spoken about, but this is what the network does.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这些只是我们讨论过的两个例子，但这正是这个网络所做的。

sentences.en: They put out stories like this, and over 17 days in July, we saw around 200 stories that were ordered up by these Republican operatives and corporate PR firMs.
sentences.zh: 他们推出这样的故事，在7月份的17天里，我们看到了大约200篇由这些共和党特工和企业公关公司点单的故事。

sentences.en: That's pretty staggering.
sentences.zh: 这真是太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: This is clearly very dubious as a journalistic practice.
sentences.zh: 从新闻业的实践来看，这显然非常可疑。

sentences.en: I mean, very dubious.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，非常可疑。

sentences.en: Is any of it illegal?
sentences.zh: 这里面有什么是违法的吗？

sentences.en: It's unclear whether any of this is actually breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚其中是否有任何行为真正触犯了法律。

sentences.en: What you can say about it is that it violates our, you know, deeply held sense of what is ethical in journalism.
sentences.zh: 你可以说的是，这违背了我们对新闻伦理根深蒂固的认知。

sentences.en: And it eschews these traditional hallmarks of journalism, of fairness and transparency.
sentences.zh: 而且它背离了新闻业公平与透明的传统标志。

sentences.en: Legally speaking, the Federal Trade Commission requires that articles that are funded be clearly labeled as ads.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，联邦贸易委员会要求有赞助的文章必须清楚地标注为广告。

sentences.en: And so it is possible in many of these cases where you have articles that are paid for and ordered up, under federal rules, these should include disclosures.
sentences.zh: 所以在许多这类付费订购文章的情况下，根据联邦法规，这些文章应该包含披露信息。

sentences.en: And in almost every case we found, there was no such labels.
sentences.zh: 但在我们发现的几乎所有案例中，都没有这样的标记。

sentences.en: How does Brian Temponi explain what he's doing here, both ethically from a journalistic standpoint and legally?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·腾波尼如何解释他在这里所做的事情，无论是从新闻伦理的角度还是从法律角度？

sentences.en: Well, Brian would not talk to us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，布莱恩不肯跟我们说话。

sentences.en: We tried calling him, texting him, leaving him voicemails, emailing him.
sentences.zh: 我们试过给他打电话、发短信、留语音信箱、发邮件。

sentences.en: I even left a note at his home, but we didn't get any response.
sentences.zh: 我甚至在他家门前留了便条，但我们没有得到任何回应。

sentences.en: But what he has said in past interviews and in public appearances is that he believes this represents a local news business model that is more sustainable than the traditional model,
sentences.zh: 但他过去在采访和公开露面时曾表示，他认为这代表了一种比传统模式更具可持续性的地方新闻商业模式，

sentences.en: which is clearly struggling.
sentences.zh: 而传统模式显然正在苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: And I just want to jump in here and say something that might seem obvious, but journalism is really expensive.
sentences.zh: 我只想插话讲一件可能显而易见的事，那就是做新闻真的很贵。

sentences.en: About 2,100 newspapers have folded across the country since 2004, which is a 25 percent decline.
sentences.zh: 自2004年以来，全国各地大约有2100家报纸倒闭，降幅达25%。

sentences.en: Almost all local newspapers.
sentences.zh: 几乎全部都是地方报纸。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what's also really interesting here is that Brian said in an interview in September with the Deseret News, which is a Utah news outlet,
sentences.zh: 这里同样非常有趣的是，布莱恩在9月份接受犹他州新闻媒体《得瑟雷特新闻》采访时表示，

sentences.en: that he has a reason for trying to save local news.
sentences.zh: 他有理由尝试拯救地方新闻。

sentences.en: And it's not ideological.
sentences.zh: 而且这无关意识形态。

sentences.en: It's actually because he believes this is a way to save the country.
sentences.zh: 实际上是因为他相信这是拯救国家的一种方式。

sentences.en: And let me read you his quote in full.
sentences.zh: 让我完整地读一下他的原话。

sentences.en: Well, he said, quote, we believe the disappearance of community news has contributed to a marked decline in civility in America.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说，我们认为社区新闻的消失导致了美国文明程度的显著下降。

sentences.en: When Americans know about their neighbors' wedding anniversaries, their work promotions,
sentences.zh: 当美国人知道邻居的结婚纪念日、工作晋升，

sentences.en: and their children making the honor roll at school or earning junior high basketball accolades, they are less likely to caricature and typecast each other over political issues.
sentences.zh: 以及他们的孩子在学校光荣榜上名列前茅或获得初中篮球荣誉时，他们就越不会在政治议题上给彼此贴标签和刻板化。

sentences.en: And what he's basically saying is that local news helps you know your neighbors.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，地方新闻能帮你了解邻居。

sentences.en: And with that, you're less likely to hate each other.
sentences.zh: 有了这一点，你们就不太可能彼此仇恨。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It's fascinating to me that he sees this approach as a force for civility because what seems so problematic about it, beyond the lack of transparency and the ethical challenges,
sentences.zh: 令我着迷的是，他把这种方法视为促进文明的力量，因为除了缺乏透明度和伦理挑战之外，它最大的问题似乎在于，

sentences.en: is that this model injects partisanship into local news.
sentences.zh: 这种模式将党派偏见注入了地方新闻。

sentences.en: And we have that already in our national news in abundance.
sentences.zh: 而我们的国家新闻中已经充斥着这些了。

sentences.en: You know, think of Fox News on the conservative side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，想想保守派的福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: Think of MSNBC on the liberal side.
sentences.zh: 想想自由派的MSNBC。

sentences.en: And we kind of know where that leads.
sentences.zh: 我们大概都知道那会通向何方。

sentences.en: It leads to a profound polarization in our national discourse.
sentences.zh: 它导致了我们国家话语中深刻的极化。

sentences.en: And yet the local news has remained, for the most part, a bastion of objective news telling, right?
sentences.zh: 然而，地方新闻在很大程度上仍然是客观新闻报道的堡垒，对吧？

sentences.en: This kind of sacred, untouched corner of the news industry.
sentences.zh: 这是新闻业里某种神圣的、未被触及的角落。

sentences.en: And stories coming out of the local school board, of a local police department, or your kid's soccer game, those are told as kind of straight news.
sentences.zh: 来自当地学校董事会、当地警察局或你孩子足球比赛的报道，这些都被作为直白的新闻来讲述。

sentences.en: But if Brian Temponi succeeds in making this the future of local news, then that version of local journalism goes away.
sentences.zh: 但如果布莱恩·腾波尼成功让这成为地方新闻的未来，那么那种版本的地方新闻业就会消失。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in our reporting, we saw that there are similar efforts on both the right and the left to create similar partisan local news outlets.
sentences.zh: 在我们的报道中，我们看到右翼和左翼都在进行类似努力，以创建类似的党派地方新闻媒体。

sentences.en: And I'll note that these are not as ambitious, but nevertheless, we have long heard about the death of local news.
sentences.zh: 我要指出的是，这些虽然没有那么雄心勃勃，但无论如何，我们长期以来一直听到地方新闻消亡的消息。

sentences.en: And often we have heard about that in the context of predictions that no one will be watching at City Hall and there will be corruption and a lack of accountability.
sentences.zh: 我们经常在这样的预测背景下听到这一说法：市议会将无人监督，并将出现腐败和缺乏问责。

sentences.en: But instead of a pure death of local news, I think what we've seen here is a rushing in of partisan interests and national money.
sentences.zh: 但我想，我们在这里看到的并非地方新闻的彻底消亡，而是党派利益和全国性资金的涌入。

sentences.en: And that has led to this more partisan version of local news, which could make civility impossible in cities and towns across the country.
sentences.zh: 这就导致了这种更具党派色彩的地方新闻版本，这可能会使全国各城镇的文明不复存在。

sentences.en: And Michael, it's worth adding that the reason anyone knows about this story at all is because of their report in a local newspaper called the Lansing State Journal in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，值得补充的是，之所以有人知道这个故事，全靠密歇根州一份名为《兰辛州报》的当地报纸的报道。

sentences.en: They were the ones that first raised questions about these sites.
sentences.zh: 是他们最先对这些网站提出了质疑。

sentences.en: And then that led to several other in-depth stories, like in the Columbia Journalism Review, and it also led to our investigation.
sentences.zh: 然后这引发了其他几篇深度报道，比如《哥伦比亚新闻评论》上的报道，也促成了我们的调查。

sentences.en: And there's something that feels very apt about that.
sentences.zh: 这感觉非常贴切。

sentences.en: The fact that it was good local journalism that uncovered this kind of twisted version of local journalism here.
sentences.zh: 正是优秀的地方新闻揭露了这里这种扭曲版本的地方新闻业。

sentences.en: That's the work that's at stake because, you know, Brian Temponi has said in a recent interview that he plans to create 15,000 more websites like this.
sentences.zh: 这就是事关重大的工作，因为，你知道，布莱恩·腾波尼在最近的一次采访中表示，他计划再创建1.5万个这样的网站。

sentences.en: This is only going to get bigger.
sentences.zh: 这只会越搞越大。

sentences.en: Davey and Jack, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 戴维和杰克，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You know, I started Googling and it was just like a medicine ball in my stomach.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我开始用谷歌搜索，感觉就像胃里挨了一个实心球。

sentences.en: It was defrauding people like me as to what our work was being used for.
sentences.zh: 这欺骗了像我这样的人，让我们误以为我们的工作被用在了什么地方。

sentences.en: And it was defrauding readers into thinking that, you know, that they were reading a local, honest publication that they could truSt.
sentences.zh: 这也欺骗了读者，让他们以为自己正在阅读一份可以信任的本地诚实出版物。

sentences.en: And are you still working for Franklin Archer?
sentences.zh: 你还在为富兰克林·阿彻工作吗？

sentences.en: No, I am not.
sentences.zh: 不，我不在了。

sentences.en: I always went for the things that I thought had integrity and community journalism, you know, which I feel very, very strongly about.
sentences.zh: 我总是追求那些我认为具有正直感和社区新闻精神的东西，你知道的，这是我深信不疑的。

sentences.en: It's stuff that I did because I believed in it.
sentences.zh: 这些是我做过的事情，因为我相信它。

sentences.en: Even if it was small town stuff, you know, small town stuff is important.
sentences.zh: 即使是小镇的事情，你知道，小镇的事情也很重要。

sentences.en: You want to know where your water comes from.
sentences.zh: 你想知道你的水是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: You know, is there stuff in your water?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，水里有什么东西吗？

sentences.en: Why did my cable bill double?
sentences.zh: 为什么我的有线电视费翻倍了？

sentences.en: So I would never, ever, ever write for, you know, anybody who is deliberately deceiving people.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对、绝对、绝对不会为任何故意欺骗人们的人写作，

sentences.en: And entire groups of people, you know, for profit.
sentences.zh: 为了利润去欺骗整群人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Data released on Tuesday from the crucial swing state of Florida shows that 6.4 million people have already voted in the state,
sentences.zh: 周二公布的关键摇摆州佛罗里达州的数据显示，该州已有640万选民投票，

sentences.en: more than two-thirds the number who voted in the entire 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 超过了2016年大选全部投票人数的三分之二。

sentences.en: The data shows that Democrats initially built up an advantage by mailing in far more ballots than Republicans,
sentences.zh: 数据显示，民主党人最初通过邮寄远超共和党的选票建立起优势，

sentences.en: but that Republicans have begun eating into Democrats' lead by casting more early in-person votes.
sentences.zh: 但共和党人已经通过现场投出更多早期选票，开始蚕食民主党的领先优势。

sentences.en: Nationwide, as of Tuesday afternoon, more than 69.5 million Americans had already mailed in their ballots or voted early in-person.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，截至周二下午，已有超过6950万美国人通过邮寄或现场提前投票。

sentences.en: A record-high early vote.
sentences.zh: 创纪录的高提前投票率。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Former President Barack Obama, who has avoided direct criticism of President Trump for much of the past four years,
sentences.zh: 前总统巴拉克·奥巴马在过去四年的大部分时间里一直避免直接批评特朗普总统，

sentences.en: delivered his most stinging and personal rebuke yet on Tuesday during a rally in Florida.
sentences.zh: 周二在佛罗里达州的一次集会上发表了他迄今为止最尖锐、最个人的斥责。

sentences.en: Except this guy can't seem to do it.
sentences.zh: 除了这家伙似乎办不到这一点。

sentences.en: He's turned the White House into a hot zone.
sentences.zh: 他把白宫变成了一个疫区。

sentences.en: Obama, campaigning for Joe Biden, expressed bewilderment that Trump had contracted the virus and dismay at the way Trump has talked about the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 为乔·拜登助选的奥巴马对特朗普感染病毒感到困惑，对特朗普谈论大流行的方式感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And, well, what's his closing argument?
sentences.zh: 而且，好吧，他的总结陈词是什么？

sentences.en: That people are too focused on COVID.
sentences.zh: 人们对新冠肺炎过于关注。

sentences.en: He said this at one of his rallies.
sentences.zh: 他在其中一次集会上这么说的。

sentences.en: COVID, COVID, COVID, he's complaining.
sentences.zh: 新冠、新冠、新冠，他在抱怨。

sentences.en: He's jealous of COVID's media coverage.
sentences.zh: 他嫉妒新冠肺炎的媒体报道。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《导线切割机秀》中，我们正准备迎接假期的聚会。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在你喜欢收听的任何地方寻找《导线切割机秀》。

sentences.en: So, we'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们明天见。
